microsoft-1970393557076180.text: Partner with engineering to design, architect and deliver eviction capabilities that turn investigation findings into coordinated, safe and reversible actions, with experiences that work for responders, automation and AI agents alike. Embed with incident responders in live incidents and exercises. Learn how containment and eviction actually happen, remove friction, and make our tooling the default way eviction work is planned, approved, executed and tracked. Define and deliver the AI roadmap for eviction: AI that helps responders understand an attacker's position and re-entry paths, plan complete and coordinated eviction, and assess the results, built with strong guardrails, human approval where impact warrants it, and a path to more autonomy as trust is earned. Make verification and learning first-class: prove the attacker is actually gone, not just that an action ran, and turn every incident's lessons into new and better capabilities. Connect the end-to-end defensive response by partnering with detection, threat hunting, investigation and threat intelligence teams so findings flow into eviction without anyone rebuilding context by hand. Shape and scale the security data that powers eviction, in partnership with IAM Protect's data platform team. Write the specs, architecture narratives and executive updates that align senior leaders and partner teams on what to fund, build and adopt next. Bachelor's degree and 6+ years of experience in engineering, product or technical program management, data analysis or product development, or equivalent experience. 3+ years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects. 3+ years of experience in security incident response, security operations, or building security products or platforms. 10+ years of experience across technical program or product management, software engineering or security operations, including taking a product or platform from early adoption to scale. Deep familiarity with containment and eviction in practice: credential and token revocation, certificate and secret rotation, identity and application disablement, endpoint isolation, and why sequencing, coordination and verification decide whether an attacker is actually gone. A track record of building platforms that other teams build on (APIs, SDKs, contracts and extensibility models) and of driving adoption across organizations through measurable outcomes and a great user experience rather than mandates. Experience shipping AI products or agentic systems into production, including LLM-based agents, tool use and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval, evaluation frameworks, human-in-the-loop design and guardrails for high-stakes actions. Experience with security orchestration, automation and response (SOAR), workflow orchestration engines or safe-deployment systems, where actions must be correct, bounded, auditable and reversible. Data platform and graph fluency: data modeling, pipelines and analytics in Azure Data Explorer (Kusto) and KQL or similar, and experience with attack graphs, knowledge graphs or entity resolution. Working knowledge of attacker tradecraft (MITRE ATT&CK, credential theft, persistence and lateral movement) and of how detection, investigation and response teams work together. Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to write the product spec, the architecture narrative and the executive one-pager, and to influence senior engineering and security leaders without direct authority.
